scope: Actual CLI same-engine output parity and descriptive process cost. This is deterministic engineering evidence, not independent scientific/model validation. Scientific NO-GO remains.

inputConstruction.summary_fixture.csv: Exact retained 72-row repro fixture bytes: 2 groups, 6 entities/group, 6 measurements/entity.
inputConstruction.repeated_conditions_8_subjects.csv: Baseline repeated_conditions.csv header and all original lines for P001-P008 in original order.

execution.calibrationDependency: After first baseline calibrate run, copy its completed calibration_state.json bytes to frozen-calibration/calibration_state.json and record hash; every analyze invocation consumes that identical immutable file. No separate calibration setup/model run.
execution.cpuAffinity: Two lowest-numbered CPUs allowed to driver at bind; frozen thereafter for all processes.
execution.environmentPolicy: Explicit minimal identical process environment, except per-invocation empty HOME, TMPDIR, MVS_APPDATA_ROOT and output paths; no inherited COMPlus/DOTNET/MVS tuning beyond frozen variables. Private empty appdata gives no installed plugins. No local settings.
execution.onFailure: Retain all evidence and continue remaining planned invocations unless dependency or frozen provenance is invalid. No replacement/cherry-picked reruns. Any incomplete run set or parity failure is reported.
execution.timingAuthorization: Do not execute until parent explicitly approves exclusive measurement window after final build/tests.

comparisons.bytePolicy: CSV and all scientific JSON are compared byte-for-byte. JSON token replacement is permitted only at enumerated metadata pointers; numeric spellings, formatting, field order, methods, row identity/order, status, nulls and all scientific values remain exact. Raw originals always retained.

calibration_state.json: /PayloadHash (derived integrity field; independently validate SHA256 of raw JSON with this one value replaced by empty string, then normalize hash of timestamp-normalized payload)
run_manifest.json: /files/*/sha256 and /files/*/SizeBytes (independently verify actual artifact first, then replace with normalized artifact hash/length so timestamp-only changes propagate correctly)
stdout.json: /artifacts/*/sha256 and /artifacts/*/sizeBytes (independently verify actual artifact first, then replace with normalized artifact hash/length)

comparisons.timestampValidation: ISO datetime parsing required before normalization. Run IDs required nonempty where manifest exists; stdout/manifest association exact.
comparisons.artifactVerification: Recompute SHA256 and size of every machine artifact from regular file on disk; require unique artifact names, exact expected file set, exact resolved path below own fresh output, complete manifest association, exact manifest file size/hash, machine manifest path and runId association; never trust declared hashes. Calibration has no manifest; all others require one.
comparisons.crossRepetition: Compare all six invocations per workload to its first baseline invocation and each matched A/B pair. Status/process exit exact. Analyze calibration copy must exactly equal frozen state bytes.
comparisons.sourceBinding: Before execution, bind exact source and binary manifests for both builds, runtime host/libcoreclr identity, input hashes, plan hash and driver hash. Check before and after execution and before each invocation. Binding refuses overwrite.
comparisons.stderr: Retain every raw stderr file; human log text is not scientific parity target.

performance.accounting: Linux wait4 usage for exact child PID, monotonic wall including startup; kernel maximum RSS. No cumulative-child RSS.
performance.report: All 30 raw metrics, all three paired B/A ratios per workload/metric, each build median/min/max and ratio median/min/max. No speed pass threshold, significance claim, cherry-rerun, or removal of first run. Three pairs are descriptive only.
limitations: Fresh process includes JIT/startup/export/hash cost; caching and shared-host noise remain possible.
Same-engine exact agreement does not establish statistical correctness.
Small minimum repetition budgets and intentionally bounded MELSM diagnostic are engineering smoke workloads.
Independent error reproduction is separate from these successful/diagnostic workloads.
